content_of_post_to_comment:
So as the title says I am stuck in this rut. It has been going on for the better part of a year. For context I am M23 and I am about to finish my last term in university getting my degree in accounting. I do not have any internships or jobs lined up and that is not the only thing on the list of things I am lacking behind on.

Classes this term have been the more difficult and more time consuming than they have ever been. On top of that I have a bad habit of vaping and smoking dab pens. This past summer I did not work but instead would fry out and play video games all day and play soccer or go to the gym 1-2 a week. This honestly is not a whole summer thing it's been like this since November 2025, only time I had not been this degenerate was when I did a study abroad term this past spring. But when I got back the cycle resumed.

I stopped going to the gym after being an avid goer for the last 3-4 years, I don't play soccer anymore, I get by in class getting help, my mornings get highjacked by me just wanting to watch YouTube vape while drink coffee. As I am typing this out It is just shameful how I live this way. I have the capability to do difficult things, but it feels like I don't have the same strong will as I used to.

I used to not vape, only smoke at night after getting my work done, going to the gym or playing soccer 5-6 times a week and had a good morning routine. Now I am just this dopamine junkie trying to get by each day.

I really want to change how I am because it feels like the walls are closing in on me and I don't want to waste doing bullshit to avoid all the stress of growing up. Everyday has felt like a blur, my brain is foggy and the days just go by so quick.

I need some advice on anyone who has been in my shoes and what they did to change. I need some strength. Life is precious and I am wasting it on things that don't do anything but get you to your grave faster.
